subject: Forrester reference request — AcmeTech advocate onboarding
messages:
From: Jamie Cho <jamie.cho@forrester.com>
To: karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 10 Jul 2026 14:12:00 +0000
Subject: Request: analyst reference for upcoming Forrester briefing

Hi Karthik,

Forrester is preparing a vendor briefing next month focused on inference runtimes and cost optimization. Would Acme Technologies be available to do a quick 30-minute customer reference call? The analyst will want to cover architecture choices, where Redwood fits into their stack, and measurable cost/latency improvements after migration.

Timing: week of Aug 3–7, ideally a 30-minute slot. We only need a speaking contact + one technical contact.

Please let me know if you have an advocate and any NDAs or consent forms we should share.

Thanks,
Jamie
Jamie Cho
Senior Analyst, Forrester Research
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: (none)
Date: Fri, 10 Jul 2026 15:05:22 +0000
Subject: Fwd: Request: analyst reference for upcoming Forrester briefing

Team — forwarding the Forrester ask. Acme has been a great reference candidate but we need to confirm two things: who at Acme is comfortable speaking publicly, and whether they need a short consent/PR release in place. I attached our standard reference_consent.pdf and the mutual_action_plan.xlsx draft to speed this.

Asks:
- Marissa: can you confirm if Acme is in our active advocate program and whether we offered credits/comp last time?
- Priyom: please call Sonia at Acme (contact in HubSpot link) to check availability and any procurement/legal constraints; copy the consent PDF.
- Monica: prepare a 3-slide briefing (internal) with the key metrics we want to highlight (latency reduction, cost per 1M tokens, rollout timeline).

Goal: lock a 30-min slot in the Aug 3–7 window; if Forrester needs earlier, see if Acme can do late July.

Karthik
Head of Sales Engineering, Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sonia Patel <sonia.patel@acmetech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 11 Jul 2026 10:18:00 -0500
Subject: Quick ask: 30-min Forrester reference call — AcmeTech

Hi Sonia,

Hope you’re well. Forrester reached out asking if Acme would be willing to speak about your experience migrating inference to Redwood. They’re planning a short vendor briefing (30 minutes) to understand architecture choices and the business impact you’ve seen.

We respect any constraints you have — typical options are: a) anonymized comments only, b) live call with Forrester and Acme speaker(s), or c) advisory-style call (non-attributable). We can provide a short consent form (attached) and a one-page talking guide.

Proposed windows (30 min):
- Tue Aug 4, 10:00–12:00 PDT
- Wed Aug 5, 14:00–16:00 PDT
- Thu Aug 6, 09:00–11:00 PDT

If one of those works, I’ll confirm with Forrester and send a calendar invite. We’ve attached: reference_consent.pdf (consent template) and mutual_action_plan.xlsx (logistics). Also pastes the HubSpot record: https://hubspot.com/contacts/AcmeTech/record/87234

Let me know any restrictions or if you want legal to review first — happy to loop them in.

Thanks so much,
Karthik
karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0189
From: Sonia Patel <sonia.patel@acmetech.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@acmetech.com>
Date: Sun, 12 Jul 2026 02:44:12 +0000
Subject: Re: Quick ask: 30-min Forrester reference call — AcmeTech

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the heads up — Acme is happy to help with analyst briefings but we have two constraints: 1) no public financial figures quoted without prior approval, and 2) legal must sign the consent form before any calls.

We can do Wed Aug 5 at 14:30 PDT (30 min). Attendees from Acme: myself (Head of Platform) and Rajiv Menon (Lead Infra Engineer). Please send the consent PDF to legal (procurement@acmetech.com) and include the Forrester agenda. If Forrester insists on an earlier time we can try late July but need at least two weeks for legal review.

Attaching a short questionnaire the team often asks for when doing references: redwood_questionnaire.pdf (quick list of topics we expect).

Best,
Sonia
Sonia Patel
Head of Platform, Acme Technologies
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jamie Cho <jamie.cho@forrester.com>, Sonia Patel <sonia.patel@acmetech.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2026 09:30:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Forrester reference request — AcmeTech advocate onboarding

Thanks Sonia and Jamie — great to confirm. Wed Aug 5, 14:30 PDT is locked on our side.

Action items:
- Karthik/Marissa: please route reference_consent.pdf to procurement@acmetech.com for signature.
- Monica: I’ll send the 3-slide brief and talking points by Jul 20 so Acme can review.
- Jamie: please share the Forrester 15-min pre-brief agenda (topics/questions) so we can align.

Attaching: mutual_action_plan.xlsx (logistics). Calendar invite to follow.

—Priyom
Business Development, Redwood Inference
